applicationStatusScreen.keepYourLicenceA.en: Keep your licence and insurance current — we re-check 30 days before expiry.

applicationStatusScreen.resubmittedAppli.en: Resubmitted applications are usually reviewed within 4 hours.

step1AuthPersonal.exactlyAsPrintedOnYour.en: Exactly as printed on your ID

vehicleClasses.enclosedRigidBodyGeneralP.en: Enclosed rigid body. General palletised and boxed cargo.
